extra_vocab.en: to repair and improve a building or room so it looks new
extra_vocab.note: 這篇主題是合約與租約續約，租賃的場地常會遇到整修。renovate 指整修建築或辦公空間，讓它變得像新的一樣。

example.en: The company renovates old offices and sells them each year.
example.zh: 這家公司每年整修舊辦公室後再出售。

example.en: The hotel renovated all of its meeting rooms last spring.
example.zh: 這家飯店去年春天整修了所有會議室。

example.en: We are renovating the lobby, so please use the side door.
example.zh: 我們正在整修大廳，請走側門。

example.en: The firm plans to renovate the building next year.
example.zh: 這家公司打算明年整修這棟大樓。

example.en: Our newly renovated office has a larger meeting room.
example.zh: 我們剛整修好的辦公室有一間更大的會議室。

example.en: We will renovate the office during the summer break.
example.zh: 我們會在暑假期間整修辦公室。

examples.en: Should we renovate the kitchen before renewing the lease?
examples.zh: 我們是否該在續約前先整修廚房？

examples.en: The contractor will renovate three floors for the new tenant.
examples.zh: 承包商會為新房客整修三個樓層。

examples.en: The store will close next week to renovate its entrance.
examples.zh: 這家店下週將暫停營業來整修入口。

confusable.diff: renew 是續約或更新期限，renovate 是整修空間，拼法相近但意思不同。

example.en: We decided to renew the lease for another two years.
example.zh: 我們決定再續約兩年的租約。

confusable.diff: innovate 是創新、推出新做法；renovate 是把舊的建築或空間整修好。

example.en: The firm must innovate to stay ahead of its competitors.
example.zh: 這家公司必須創新，才能領先競爭對手。

similar.diff: remodel 偏重改變格局和外觀；renovate 偏重把舊的地方整修成新的。

example.en: They plan to remodel the lobby and add a reception desk.
example.zh: 他們打算改造大廳並增設接待櫃台。

example.en: The technician will repair the air conditioner this afternoon.
example.zh: 技師今天下午會修理冷氣機。

example.en: Our team maintains all the equipment in the building.
example.zh: 我們的團隊負責維護大樓裡的所有設備。

example.en: The company will construct a new warehouse next year.
example.zh: 公司明年會建造一座新倉庫。

derived.link: renovate 去掉 e 再加 -ion，把「整修」變成名詞，像 create → creation

extra_vocab.en: an arrangement to pay regularly to receive a service or product
extra_vocab.note: 這篇的維護合約也是定期付費的服務，subscription 的概念很像：定期付款，到期時要決定是否續訂。常見於軟體、雜誌和會員服務。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「訂閱某樣東西」的介系詞用 to，例如 a subscription to the magazine，不用 for。

example.en: Our company pays for ten software subscriptions each month.
example.zh: 我們公司每個月支付十個軟體訂閱的費用。

example.en: Please renew your subscription before it expires on Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五到期前續訂。

example.en: You can cancel the subscription at any time online.
example.zh: 您可以隨時在線上取消訂閱。

example.en: An annual subscription costs less than paying every month.
example.zh: 年度訂閱比每個月付款便宜。

example.en: The monthly subscription fee includes free technical support and updates.
example.zh: 每月訂閱費包含免費的技術支援和更新。

examples.en: Thank you for your subscription to our business newsletter.
examples.zh: 感謝您訂閱我們的商業電子報。

examples.en: We should compare subscription plans before choosing a software vendor.
examples.zh: 我們應該先比較訂閱方案，再選軟體廠商。

examples.en: Does the subscription include a free trial period first?
examples.zh: 這個訂閱方案一開始有包含免費試用期嗎？

confusable.diff: description 是「描述、說明」，和 subscription 的字尾相同，容易看錯；subscription 是訂閱。

example.en: Please read the product description before you place an order.
example.zh: 下訂單前，請先閱讀產品說明。

similar.diff: membership 是成為會員的資格；subscription 強調定期付費取得服務或內容。

example.en: Gold membership includes free shipping on all orders.
example.zh: 金卡會員資格包含所有訂單免運費。

similar.diff: service plan 是服務方案，著重內容和價格組合；subscription 著重定期付費這件事。

example.en: Which service plan gives us the lowest monthly rate?
example.zh: 哪個服務方案能給我們最低的月費？

example.en: The basic plan costs twenty dollars per month.
example.zh: 基本方案每個月二十美元。

example.en: Automatic renewal can be turned off in your account.
example.zh: 自動續訂功能可以在您的帳戶中關閉。

example.en: We offer a thirty-day free trial for new users.
example.zh: 我們提供新用戶三十天的免費試用。

derived.link: subscribe 是動詞原形；變名詞時字尾變成 -ription，像 describe → description

senses.en: regular payment to receive a magazine, a service, or software

example.en: My subscription to the trade magazine ends in December.
example.zh: 我訂閱的行業雜誌在十二月結束。

senses.en: money you pay regularly to belong to a club or group
senses.distinguish: 指加入俱樂部或協會定期繳的費用，英式用法較常見；訂閱則針對雜誌、軟體或服務。

example.en: The annual club subscription is due at the start of January.
example.zh: 俱樂部的年費在一月初到期。

extra_vocab.en: when you talk about one part of something
extra_vocab.note: 在談判或比較方案時，用來限定討論的面向，例如 in terms of price（就價格而言）或 in terms of contract length。注意它和合約裡的 terms（條款）是不同的用法。
extra_vocab.pattern: in terms of + N（價格／品質／時間）, S + V
extra_vocab.grammar_note: terms 一定要加 s，不能寫 in term of；of 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing。

examples.en: In terms of price, the second vendor is clearly better.
examples.zh: 就價格而言，第二家廠商明顯比較好。

examples.en: We are satisfied in terms of both quality and delivery.
examples.zh: 就品質與交貨兩方面，我們都很滿意。

examples.en: The new model is better in terms of energy use.
examples.zh: 就能源使用而言，新型號比較好。

examples.en: In terms of location, this hotel is very convenient.
examples.zh: 就地點而言，這家飯店非常方便。

similar.diff: regarding 是「關於」，用來引出話題；in terms of 則是限定要比較或評估的面向。

example.en: I am writing regarding the delay in your order.
example.zh: 我來信是關於您訂單的延誤。

similar.diff: 語氣較口語，意思是「說到…」，to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing。

example.en: When it comes to pricing, our supplier is flexible.
example.zh: 說到定價，我們的供應商很有彈性。

confusable.diff: under the terms of 是「依據…的條款」，指合約規定；in terms of 是「就…方面」。

example.en: Under the terms of the contract, we can cancel early.
example.zh: 依據合約條款，我們可以提前取消。

extra_vocab.en: the rules and details that both sides agree to in a contract
extra_vocab.note: 對話裡女士說 I'll review the terms，指的就是檢視合約條款；terms and conditions 是更完整的說法，常縮寫成 T&C，在網站和合約中都很常見。
extra_vocab.pattern: read / accept / review + the terms and conditions
extra_vocab.grammar_note: terms and conditions 通常視為複數，動詞用 are／apply，例如 The terms and conditions are listed below。

examples.en: Please read the terms and conditions carefully before signing.
examples.zh: 簽名前請仔細閱讀條款與條件。

examples.en: The vendor refused to change the terms and conditions.
examples.zh: 廠商拒絕更改條款與條件。

examples.en: The updated terms and conditions will take effect next month.
examples.zh: 更新後的條款與條件將於下個月生效。

examples.en: Check whether the terms and conditions include free repairs.
examples.zh: 請確認條款與條件是否包含免費維修。

examples.en: You must accept the terms and conditions to create an account.
examples.zh: 您必須接受條款與條件才能建立帳戶。

similar.diff: terms of service 多指網站或線上服務的使用規範；terms and conditions 範圍更廣，也包含一般合約。

example.en: By using this app, you agree to the terms of service.
example.zh: 使用這個應用程式，即表示您同意服務條款。

similar.diff: contract terms 專指合約內的條款，不一定包含「條件」的說法。

example.en: We need to review the contract terms before signing.
example.zh: 我們簽約前需要先審閱合約條款。

confusable.diff: 單數 term 常指期限，複數 terms 才是條款。
confusable.usage: 說「條款」時一定用複數 terms；單數 term 多指期限或學期，如 a longer term。

example.en: A longer term could lower the monthly rate.
example.zh: 較長的期限可能降低月費。

extra_vocab.en: a person or company that owns a building and rents it to others
extra_vocab.note: 在「The landlord waived the late payment penalty for this month.」中，landlord 是收租金、決定要不要免除罰款的一方，角色就像這篇對話裡可議價的 vendor。

example.en: Some landlords offer discounts to tenants who sign longer leases.
example.zh: 有些房東會給簽較長租約的房客折扣。

example.en: The landlord and tenant signed a new two-year lease.
example.zh: 房東與房客簽了一份新的兩年租約。

example.en: Please contact the landlord about the broken heater.
example.zh: 請就壞掉的暖氣聯絡房東。

example.en: We need the landlord's approval before we change the layout.
example.zh: 更改格局前，我們需要房東的同意。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to lower the rent by five percent.
examples.zh: 房東同意把租金降低百分之五。

examples.en: I sent the landlord a copy of the signed lease.
examples.zh: 我寄了一份已簽署的租約給房東。

examples.en: The landlord is responsible for repairing the roof and walls.
examples.zh: 房東負責修繕屋頂和牆壁。

confusable.diff: tenant 是承租人、房客；landlord 是出租人，兩者角色相反。

example.en: The tenant must pay the rent by the first of the month.
example.zh: 房客必須在每月一日前繳租金。

similar.diff: property owner 是「物業擁有者」，語氣較中性，不一定有出租給別人。

example.en: The property owner will visit the office on Monday.
example.zh: 物業所有人星期一會到辦公室來。

example.en: The lease ends in June, so we must decide soon.
example.zh: 租約六月到期，所以我們必須儘快決定。

example.en: The rent for this office rose by eight percent.
example.zh: 這間辦公室的租金上漲了百分之八。

example.en: The company owns several properties in the city center.
example.zh: 這家公司在市中心擁有幾處物業。

extra_vocab.text: If we signed for three years instead of one, they might even waive the installation fee.
extra_vocab.zh: 如果我們簽三年而不是一年，他們甚至可能免收安裝費。
extra_vocab.note: 女士順著男士的想法，推測簽長約可以換到更多優惠。用 might even 讓語氣保守，帶有「說不定還能…」的期待。
extra_vocab.structure: If + S + 過去式（假設）, S + might + (even) + V + O

grammar.point: if + 過去式, might + 原形
grammar.explain: 用過去式 signed 表示「假設的情況」，不是指過去；主要子句用 might（或 would）加原形，說出可能的結果，語氣比 will 更保守。
instead of 後面接名詞或 V-ing，表示「而不是…」；這裡的 one 是代替 year，避免重複 for one year。
even 放在 might 後面、動詞前，加強語氣，表示「甚至可能」，暗示結果比預期更好。

extra_vocab.pattern: If + S + 過去式 + 條件, S + might even + V + 結果

paraphrase.en: A three-year contract, not a one-year one, might even get us free installation.
paraphrase.zh: 三年的合約，而不是一年的，說不定還能讓我們免費安裝。

paraphrase.en: The vendor might not charge us for installation if we choose three years over one.
paraphrase.zh: 如果我們選三年而不是一年，廠商可能不會收安裝費。

examples.en: If we paid in advance, they might even give us a discount.
examples.zh: 如果我們預先付款，他們甚至可能給我們折扣。

examples.en: If you ordered fifty units, the supplier might even offer free shipping.
examples.zh: 如果您訂五十件，供應商甚至可能提供免運費。

extra_vocab.en: to say that someone does not have to pay a penalty
extra_vocab.note: 在「We are happy to waive the penalty because this was our mistake.」中，是公司主動承認錯誤並免除罰款，語氣客氣、有誠意，常見於道歉信或客服回覆。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: waive 是及物動詞，直接接費用當受詞（waive the penalty），不加 on 或 for；對象用 for + 人，如 waive the penalty for the customer。

examples.en: We will waive the penalty if payment arrives by Friday.
examples.zh: 如果款項在星期五前到，我們會免除罰款。

examples.en: Could the vendor waive the penalty for the first delay?
examples.zh: 廠商可以免除第一次延誤的罰款嗎？

examples.en: As a favor, the bank agreed to waive the penalty.
examples.zh: 銀行基於通融，同意免除罰款。

examples.en: The agreement allows us to waive the penalty in special cases.
examples.zh: 協議允許我們在特殊情況下免除罰款。

similar.diff: 較口語，只是把罰款拿掉；waive 則有「放棄收取的權利」的正式語感。

example.en: The manager decided to remove the penalty from the invoice.
example.zh: 經理決定把發票上的罰款拿掉。

similar.diff: 結構相同，只是對象換成逾期費，指付款晚了才加收的費用。

example.en: The landlord agreed to waive the late fee this month.
example.zh: 房東同意這個月免收逾期費。

confusable.diff: wave 與 waive 發音相同，但 wave 是揮手、波浪；waive 才是免除。

example.en: He gave a quick wave and left the meeting room.
example.zh: 他快速揮了揮手，離開了會議室。

extra_vocab.zh: 費用減免、免收費用的許可
extra_vocab.en: an approval to not pay a fee that others must pay
extra_vocab.note: 在「Students can apply for a fee waiver on the website.」中，fee waiver 是名詞，指經申請後可以不用繳費的資格，常見於學費、報名費和安裝費。
extra_vocab.pattern: apply for / request / get + a fee waiver
extra_vocab.grammar_note: waiver 是名詞，fee waiver 是可數名詞，可加 a 或 s；表示「免收」這個動作要用動詞 waive，如 waive the fee。

examples.en: You may request a fee waiver by replying to this email.
examples.zh: 您可以回覆這封電子郵件申請費用減免。

examples.en: A fee waiver would make the three-year plan more attractive.
examples.zh: 免收費用會讓三年的方案更有吸引力。

examples.en: The vendor offered a fee waiver for the first installation.
examples.zh: 廠商為第一次安裝提供了費用減免。

examples.en: Employees can get a fee waiver for approved training courses.
examples.zh: 員工參加核准的培訓課程可以獲得費用減免。

similar.diff: exemption 是依規定本來就不用繳；waiver 是對方同意放棄收取。

example.en: Nonprofit groups receive a fee exemption under the new rule.
example.zh: 依新規定，非營利團體可免繳費用。

similar.diff: 只是減少費用，不是完全免除；fee waiver 則是整筆不用付。

example.en: The vendor offered a fee reduction of ten percent.
example.zh: 廠商提供了百分之十的費用減免。

confusable.diff: waver 是動詞，指猶豫不決；waiver 是名詞，指免除。拼法很接近。
confusable.usage: waiver 是名詞（a waiver），waver 是動詞（waver on a decision），詞性不同，不能互換。

example.en: The team began to waver after the price went up.
example.zh: 價格上漲後，團隊開始猶豫了。
